reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with SpotBot
reauth_confirm.description: Your SpotBot session is no longer valid (the refresh token expired or the linked device was removed from your account). Sign in again with your phone number and OTP to continue.

abort.already_configured: This SpotBot account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A configuration flow for SpotBot is already in progress.
abort.oauth_error: Received invalid token data from the SpotBot OAuth server.
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining an access token from SpotBot.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: SpotBot rejected the authorization request. Check the client credentials.
abort.missing_configuration: SpotBot application credentials are not configured. Add them under Settings > Devices & Services > Application Credentials first.
abort.missing_credentials: SpotBot application credentials are not configured. Add them under Settings > Devices & Services > Application Credentials first.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timeout generating the SpotBot authorize URL.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. Check your Home Assistant external URL configuration.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not fetch your SpotBot account details. Check that the SpotBot API is reachable and try again.
abort.wrong_account: The account you signed in with does not match the account this entry was created for.

application_credentials.description: SpotBot uses OAuth2 with a confidential client. Request the Home Assistant client ID and client secret from SpotBot support (support@spotbot.co.za), then enter them here. Signing in happens on the SpotBot login page with your phone number and a one-time PIN — no password or extra account is needed. See {docs_url} for a walkthrough. The OAuth server is {oauth_url}.
